reasons: Section 21.1 tracks the model language exactly: a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, expressly stated to be mutual and applicable regardless of form of action, so no walk-away trigger (one-sided cap or sub-6-month basis) exists.

21.2 is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages with direct-damage carve-ins that favour Customer (data restoration, replacement services, notification, incident response), so it should not be flagged.

21.3 places every preferred carve-out (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, infringement of the other Party's IP) outside the cap and confirms Customer's undisputed Fee obligation is not 'damages' — indemnities are therefore not inside the cap.

'Fees' (1.5) captures recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is substantive rather than illusory; the exclusion of one-time implementation charges is a minor sub-element properly noted in the rationale rather than flagged.

Consistent with the compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the deterministic checks (12-month/fixed-floor basis present; no unlimited Customer liability language) both pass.
